pool: Ready players can be drafted. More than 12 can be ready; each match has 12 players.
attendance: Ready: available to draft. Sit out: skip one match, then return. Away: unavailable tonight. Current team slots stay assigned when availability changes. Undrafted players join or leave the captain pool immediately.
mode: Balanced random favors similar team ratings and offers two heroes each. Random creates teams without rolling heroes. Captains use snake picks. Manual teams support drag and drop.
patch: Use the latest titled patch for new matches. Untitled build updates are excluded.
bias: Higher values prefer closer team estimates. This changes team assignment, not who sits out.
statistics: Show or hide player ratings, game counts, and team estimates on the draft screen. Ratings still balance teams and appear in Stats.
estimate: Win chance estimated from overall ratings and uncertainty. It does not measure individual contribution.
rating: Conservative OpenSkill rating: mu minus three times sigma. Fewer recorded games mean greater uncertainty.
heroes: Roll two hero options per player in a shuffled order. Each player glows pink for one second. This replaces existing selections and follows the random ban list and duplicate setting.
heroesUnselected: Roll two options only for players who have not selected a hero. Selected heroes and their reserved options stay unchanged. Uses the random ban list and duplicate setting.
hero: Choose a hero. Normal random draws offer two options and respect the random ban list. Shared heroes require Allow duplicate heroes.
firstBan: The first banning side gets the last player pick. Captains are already assigned. Second bans occur after three drafted picks per team.
drag: Drag a ready player from the left pool to an empty slot. In captain mode, drop on the side whose turn it is.
result: Complete both teams, assign a hero to every player, select the winner, and record the match. Shared heroes require Allow duplicate heroes.
preferences: Avoid makes a hero much less likely in random draws, but does not ban it. Comfort, Prefer, and Favorite give small increases. Neutral keeps the normal weight.
profileImport: Import one player's preference file. Choose an existing player to update, or add them as new. Match records and ratings stay intact.
records: Export a backup of all records. Import replaces the current records after validation and confirmation.
correction: A result correction keeps the previous winner in the edit history and recalculates ratings.
patchRefresh: Load titled patches from the shipped catalog. Dates use UTC. Existing match records are preserved.
timeline: Ratings carry across patches. Vertical markers show patch changes. The band shows one sigma around the conservative rating.
prediction: Brier score measures prediction error. Lower is better. Predictions do not show whether captain choices caused a win.
winnerEstimate: Average draft-time probability assigned to the team that won.
ratingModel: OpenSkill Plackett–Luce uses team wins and losses. It does not measure individual contribution. Fewer games mean greater uncertainty. Patch filters show records from that patch and ratings at its end.
replace: Export a backup before starting fresh. Empty JSON downloads the configured starting records.
notes: Optional player notes. Notes are included in the player's preference file.
profile: Fill in your name and hero preferences. Download the JSON file and send it to the lobby leader. This page does not edit the leader's roster.
duplicateHeroes: Players can share the same hero. Each player still gets two different options. Turning this off keeps assigned heroes but clears reserved options.
randomBans: Checked heroes are excluded from normal random rolls. Manual selection is still allowed. Rat King is excluded by default.
ratKingCase: One standalone hero roll. Rat King is always in this pool, even when excluded from normal random rolls. This does not change team assignments.
mode_balanced: Draw 12 ready players and favor teams with similar ratings. Each player gets two hero choices.
mode_random: Draw 12 ready players and split teams without rating balance. Select heroes manually or use Random heroes when ready.
mode_captains: Choose two captains, then use snake picks. Optional hero bans follow the selected pick order.
mode_manual: Drag players from the left pool into team slots. Assigned players can be dragged to another empty slot. Random heroes remain available.
